summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly report on new residential construction for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: Table 5b ("Not seasonally adjusted") provides monthly data for "New Privately-Owned Housing Units Completed," specifically the "1 unit" (single-family) category for the "West" region. The document lists 23.5 thousand units completed in August 2022. This report covers only the starting month of the requested period (August 2022) and does not extend through May 2025; its data serves as the initial point for the timeframe and is marked preliminary, meaning it may be subject to revision by later reports in the collection.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (September 2022, released October 19, 2022). Relevant to the task: Table 5b provides "Not seasonally adjusted" New Privately-Owned Housing Units Completed data. For the West region, single-family (1 unit) category, this document lists monthly figures in thousands: 23.5 for August 2022 and 18.5 for September 2022. This contributes the initial portion of the requested period (2022/08–2022/09) but does not cover data for the remainder of the required timeframe (2022/10 through 2025/05).

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical report on New Residential Construction for October 2022 (released November 17, 2022). For the West region, single-family (1 unit) completions are listed as 23.9 thousand for August 2022, 19.5 thousand for September 2022, and 19.6 thousand for October 2022. This document contributes the earliest monthly data points for the required 2022/08 to 2025/05 period but does not cover the full timeframe; as an initial release, these revised and preliminary values are subject to potential updates by later reports in the collection.
